title: Het voorbijrijden van een ambulance met sirene - SoundCloud - Beeld en Geluid
author: Beeld en Geluid
changes: A real Dutch ambulance driving away just after passing, its siren switching between high and low notes ('nee-naw'). Trimmed to 32.90–35.82 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Field recording ('An ambulance passing with its siren', recorded at Crailo, the Netherlands) from the Netherlands Institute for Sound and Vision's Geluid van Nederland collection.
